g.text: Release signatures — mathematical validity is not publisher trust
Primary RSA key only; no subkey adoption
No input views, reader, network or process
No revocation, expiry or Native authority proof
Canonical text hash binds later selection
Issuer hints never select a different key
Selected size1..16MiB; empty other rows allowed
Date claims do not establish trusted time
bounded private snapshots and exact fingerprint
canonical text + hashed header + v4 trailer
verify full preimage; prefix alone is insufficient
unique exact SHA256 row and repository identity
